observations.body: Simon’s mother-in-law is rebuked free of fever, serves immediately, and is followed by healings, solitude, and continued proclamation.
observations.label: Simon’s household in Luke

observations.body: The passage presents Rebuking fever and continued proclamation as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Rebuking fever and continued proclamation

observations.body: The passage places Peter beside Rebuking fever and continued proclamation.
observations.label: Peter

payload.posture: Read Luke 4:38–44 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The crowds seek to keep Jesus
